Tracker: linear. Use the linear MCP tools exposed in this session (MCP server `linear`): the get-issue operation (tool `linear_get_issue`), the list-comments operation (tool `linear_list_comments`), and the create-comment operation (tool `linear_save_comment`). No shell command reaches this tracker.
If no tool for this tracker is available in this session, or a call fails, do not improvise or skip: emit status blocked with blocker.reason `tracker_tool_unavailable` (for a write) or `plan_missing_context` (for a read), with blocker.details naming the tracker, the operation and the error.
